Quick guide

Choose a dataset and press Start training. Each epoch is one pass through all 160 points.

The network takes a point’s x and y coordinates and predicts its class. Thicker connections carry larger weights. Purple weights are positive and teal weights are negative.

The dots show the true classes. The background shows the network’s prediction at each location. Watch the regions change as training loss falls.

Try a different learning rate while training. Changing the dataset or activation starts a fresh experiment.
